title: Add workflow metrics collector + scheduled workflow

issue.description: Create a Node script that collects AI agent workflow health metrics (CI failure rate per PR, time-to-merge-ready, fleet runs, per-agent acceptance/change-request/revert rates) from the GitHub API and outputs JSON + Markdown. Add a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that runs it weekly. No new npm dependencies; degrade gracefully when gh is unauthenticated.

sampleCandidate.notes: Known-good reference candidate for regression testing the scorecard.

rubric.description: The collector script and its scheduled workflow both exist on disk.
Candidate touched both the collector script and the workflow.
Candidate did not edit shared/owned files (package.json, packages, services, apps, owned workflows).
Script prints a clear message and exits 0 when gh is missing or unauthenticated.
rubric.guidance: Reviewer/model confirms the no-auth path exits 0 with an actionable message.

rubric.description: Metrics that cannot be derived are emitted as null with an explanatory note.
rubric.guidance: Reviewer/model confirms null + notes for non-derivable metrics.
